messages.text: I’ll inspect the editor, workspace flow, and visible tests, then make the save timing change and run the relevant checks.

The editor needs to flush a pending save when leaving a document, and `submit()` needs to flush before capturing its receipt. I’ll use one trailing task per editor visit so a callback during a save cannot carry an old batch into a reopened document.

The main checks passed for coalescing, later save bursts, close/open flushing, submission, and save callbacks that navigate. I’m checking one remaining edge: a submission save callback can change the active visit before the receipt notice is shown.

The draft editor now uses the existing trailing-task utility to save only the latest text after 120 ms of quiet. Later editing bursts still save. Closing or switching documents flushes pending text, and submitting flushes it before the receipt is captured. The search preview was left unchanged.

Controlled-timer checks passed for these paths, including save callbacks that navigate and submission notices tied to the original editor visit. No test suite is configured in the workspace. `git diff --check` could not run because this workspace is not a Git repository.
